_comment: Canonical Mistral catalog (pricing) facts. MANUALLY MAINTAINED — unlike the other provider-direct sources, Mistral publishes NO machine-readable price source (mistral.ai/pricing and docs.mistral.ai/.../pricing are both JS-rendered SPAs with scattered, self-conflicting price text and no static table / JSON island). Per the Phase 4.6 T5 decision, prices here are MANUALLY VERIFIED from the rendered mistral.ai/pricing page and updated by hand; update/extract_mistral_catalog.py only DRIFT-CHECKS that the committed model names still appear on the page (it does NOT parse prices). Re-verify prices manually when the page changes. Consumed OFFLINE by update/merge_catalog.py + update/validate_catalog_conformance.py. overlay_mode whole-element: Mistral is not on Cursor's pricing page, so the catalog cron's Opus pass drops these models and the de-clobber overlay re-adds them from the committed selector.
